title: wana make ai animations like this roaring kitty?
author: missEves
selftext:
now you can!

just input a reference image and describe the action you want

export game-ready sprite sheets or animated videos just for fun

try it @ [playmix.ai/animate](https://playmix.ai/animate)

comments.author: op_app_pewer
comments.body: Or dreamforge.ai if you want the animation, and also a coding agent to create a game with it for you:)

replies.author: missEves
replies.body: you can also vibe create games on playmix!

comments.author: EeviKat
comments.body: The animations seem decent but the size appears extremely limited, I tried uploading a sprite for a character and it cut off like 50% of her body and only animated her torso.

replies.author: missEves
replies.body: try zooming out your reference image to give more space for the character to move around during the animation

replies.author: missEves
replies.body:
just released a way to do this automatically

check the zoom out option before animating
